question: In an ecosystem, physical factors like temperature, rainfall, wind, soil and minerals are:
solution:
The correct answer is __**abiotic components**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Abiotic components** refer to the non-living physical and chemical elements in an ecosystem.
 
• These components include factors such as **temperature, rainfall, wind, soil, and minerals**.
 
• Abiotic factors significantly influence the types of organisms that can live in an ecosystem and their distribution.
 
• Examples of abiotic components also include sunlight, water, air, and nutrients.
 
• Abiotic components interact with biotic components (living organisms) to create a balanced ecosystem.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Biotic Components**:

 
 
• Biotic components are the living organisms in an ecosystem, such as plants, animals, fungi, and microorganisms.
 
• They interact with abiotic components to sustain life and maintain ecological balance.
 
 
 
• **Decomposers**:
 
 
• Decomposers are organisms like bacteria and fungi that break down dead organic matter, returning nutrients to the soil.
 
• They play a crucial role in nutrient cycling within ecosystems.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Abiotic Factors**:
 
 
• Abiotic factors determine the physical environment in which biotic components live.
 
• They influence growth rates, reproductive success, and survival of organisms.
 
 
 
• **Interaction of Abiotic and Biotic Factors**:
 
 
• Both sets of components interact to create a dynamic and functional ecosystem.
 
• Changes in abiotic factors can lead to shifts in the types of biotic communities present.
